title: bug(plugin-kanban): bucketCardsIntoColumns double-buckets every record when a lane id is not a string — knownIds holds raw ids while the group keys are always strings
body:
Found by the `os-dev` seat during the contract-review rework of objectui#8913 (PR #8989), and reproduced independently of the review that first reported it. ⛔ Not repaired there: objectui#8913 is an authoring-face declaration, and this is a renderer behaviour change with its own blast radius.

Unclaimed and unprioritised on purpose — triage owns both.

## The defect

`bucketCardsIntoColumns` (`packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`) decides lane membership twice, with two different key types, and they disagree when a lane `id` is not a string:

- **injection** reads `groups[col.id]`. A JS property read coerces the key, so a lane `{ id: 1 }` correctly picks up the group stored under `'1'`.
- **the leftover sweep** builds `const knownIds = new Set(columns.map((col) => col.id))` from the RAW value and then filters `Object.keys(groups)` — which are ALWAYS strings — with `!knownIds.has(key)`. `new Set([1]).has('1')` is `false`.

⇒ every record whose group value belongs to a numeric lane is injected into that lane **and** swept into the trailing `Uncategorized` lane. The card renders **twice**.

## Reproduction — the real function, with a control leg

Runnable as a vitest file anywhere under `packages/plugin-kanban/src/`; it calls the exported function directly, mounts nothing:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { bucketCardsIntoColumns } from './index';

const summarise = (lanes: any[]) =>
  lanes.map((l) => `${String(l.id)}:${(l.cards || []).map((c: any) => c.id).join('+')}`).join(', ');

describe('numeric lane ids double-bucket', () => {
  it('NUMERIC', () => {
    expect(summarise(bucketCardsIntoColumns(
      [{ id: 1, title: 'One' }, { id: 2, title: 'Two' }],
      [{ id: 'r1', status: 1 }, { id: 'r2', status: '2' }],
      'status', undefined, 'Uncategorized',
    ))).toBe('1:r1, 2:r2');            // MEASURED: '1:r1, 2:r2, __uncolumned__:r1+r2'
  });

  it('STRING control', () => {
    expect(summarise(bucketCardsIntoColumns(
      [{ id: 'one', title: 'One' }],
      [{ id: 'r1', status: 'one' }],
      'status', undefined, 'Uncategorized',
    ))).toBe('one:r1');                // MEASURED: 'one:r1' — clean, so the reading above is about the id TYPE
  });
});
```

Measured on `claude/issue-8913-object-kanban-columns-declared` at `aa467bc` (the function is byte-identical to `origin/main`):

```
NUMERIC lane ids -> 1:r1, 2:r2, __uncolumned__:r1+r2
STRING control   -> one:r1
```

The control leg is what makes the first line a reading rather than an artefact of the harness.

## Why nothing catches it today

- `KanbanColumn.id` and `KanbanColumnSchema.id` are both `string`, and after PR #8989 `ObjectKanbanSchema.columns[].id` is `string` too — so a numeric lane id is now refused at the authoring boundary on every published face. **That closes the AUTHORED path, not the defect.**
- The lanes the renderer materialises itself are built with `id: opt.value` from the object definition's picklist options, and `id: String(g)` from the data. So a picklist whose option `value` is a **number in real metadata** reaches this function with a numeric `id` through a path no schema guards. Whether such metadata exists in production was NOT measured here.
- `index.bucket.test.ts` covers the leftover sweep (#2792) with string ids only.

## Fix sketch (not prescriptive)

Key both sides the same way — `new Set(columns.map((col) => String(col.id)))`, and read `groups[String(col.id)]` — so injection and the sweep agree. Any fix wants the two probes above kept as a pin, because the failure is silent: the board renders, the totals just do not reconcile.

⚠️ It is a renderer behaviour change: today a numeric-id board shows every card twice, after a fix it shows each once. That is a visible difference for anyone whose metadata already hits this.

## Related reading, recorded but NOT part of this card

`effectiveColumns` (`packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`) dispatches on `columns[0]` alone, so a MIXED array is mishandled in both orders. Measured with `[{ id: 'done', title: 'Done' }, 'todo']`: `done:r2, undefined:, __uncolumned__:r1` — a blank lane whose own keys are `["0","1","2","3","cards"]` (the string spread character by character) and the `todo` record in "Uncategorized". PR #8989 now refuses a mixed array at the authoring boundary, so there is no authored path to it; it is written down here only so the next reader of this function does not rediscover it.

Refs: objectui#8913 / PR #8989 · objectui#2792 · objectui#8990.

Filed by Claude Code for the `os-dev` seat on objectui#8913; the session reference is `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`.
